authorization: One bounded synthetic tensor check; no model weights or language generation.
model_config_path: Pinned authormist model configuration; public runtime model configuration is native/model-config.json
reference: CPU float32 explicit Qwen2 eager expression; same rounded bfloat16 input values
secondary_reference: CPU bfloat16 built-in SDPA with enable_gqa=True
comparison: MPS bfloat16 built-in SDPA, same-call repeat, and explicit Qwen2 eager expression
metrics: count absolute error above0.01 or nonfinite
threshold_interpretation: 0.01 is upstream reproducer diagnostic threshold, not a whole-model quality guarantee. Large above-control deviations identify tensor-path failure only.
classification: Synthetic implementation diagnosis outside prior language-generation counts; does not rerun or modify completed trial.
